events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey walker scripts for job and finding handling
events.input: $ wc -l app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/scripts/run-chain.sh && grep -n -i "job\|finding\|kie\|process.env\|sleep\|setTimeout" app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs | head -80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey UI walker, run-chain script and coord log lines
events.input: $ grep -n -i "job\|finding\|kie\|process.env\|sleep\|setTimeout" app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs | head -80; echo ---; grep -n -i "walk\|kie\|sim\|8787\|PORT" app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -40; echo ---; git diff --stat -- app/scripts/run-chain.sh; grep -n "2026-10-07 01:41\|2026-10-07 05:15" docs/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | cut -c1-900

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check walker commit state, settle code, and local stack
events.input: $ git status --short -- app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs; git log --oneline -4 -- app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs; git status -sb | head -1; git diff -- app/scripts/run-chain.sh; sed -n 284,298p app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs; ls -d /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md docs/tantra-round5-coord 2>&1; ls -la /tmp/rc-local-admin-url /tmp/walk/*/report.json 2>&1 | head; for p in 8790 8791 8792 8794; do printf "$p "; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$p/; done; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-ro

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the three UI walkers against the local centre and simulator
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app && date && ADMIN=$(cat /tmp/rc-local-admin-url) && for s in webinar challenge rsp; do node scripts/walk-ui.mjs "$ADMIN" $s > /tmp/t242-walk-$s.log 2>&1; echo "$s exit $?"; grep -a "jobs settle\|cards done" /tmp/t242-walk-$s.log | tail -3; done; date

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read walker runner, chain tail, coord log mentions and previous reports
events.input: $ sed -n 8,22p app/scripts/walk-scenarios.mjs; sed -n 14,28p app/scripts/run-chain.sh; sed -n 72,79p app/scripts/run-chain.sh; grep -n "T-242\|Kie" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -6 | cut -c1-400; ls -la docs 2>&1 | head -5; python3 - <<'E'
